title: wkappbot taskkill: classify and kill wkappbot processes
desc: taskkill CLASSIFY: shows full cmdline per process (2 lines). Zombie Eye cleanup after long uptime.
steps:
CLASSIFY (callout popup, no actual kill): wkappbot taskkill /IM wkappbot-core.exe
Each match = 2 lines:
  Line1: PID {id} {image} [{ctime}] reason PROTECTED/ZOMBIE/UNKNOWN
  Line2:       > full command line (not truncated)
Force-kill: wkappbot taskkill --force 1234,5678

Zombie Eye cleanup (100+ procs after 24h):
High CPU = old Eye daemon. Kill all but newest:
  Get-Process wkappbot-core

--force PID: CDP port guard (--remote-debugging-port) is now bypassed when --force + explicit PID list are both provided (Core fix 9e62e69e7). Chrome CDP sessions are killable via --force without --arg workaround.

PENDING behavior improvement (suggest filed 2026-05-26): /IM should auto-kill non-protected (ZOMBIE/UNKNOWN) processes immediately like Windows taskkill; PROTECTED shown separately with '--force <pids>' hint. Per-process info should include: PID, caller window, CPU%, memory, handle count, thread count (in addition to existing cmdline). Currently /IM = classify-only, blank > for zombie cmdlines.

TEST A verified 2026-05-26: wkappbot taskkill --force 17076 killed live CDP Chrome (--remote-debugging-port=9982) via WM_CLOSE gracefully after Core fix 9e62e69e7. Build clean+publish succeeded on retry (CS0009 transient artifact fixed by dotnet clean first).

CMDLINE FILTER (wkzombie proprietary, 2026-05-28): zombie-watchdog.ps1 supports -CmdlineFilter <string> to restrict kills to processes whose cmdline contains the pattern (wildcard *filter* match via Get-CimInstance Win32_Process). Equivalent to Windows taskkill /FI 'COMMANDLINE contains X' but applied to wkappbot-core only. Usage: ./wkzombie.ps1 -MaxAge 45 -CmdlineFilter eye -- kills only eye-port zombies. ./wkzombie.ps1 -MaxAge 45 -CmdlineFilter 9740 -- kills only port-9740 workers. No filter = kill all stale workers (default). Singleton: each new instance auto-kills previous via TEMP/wkzombie.pid.

SMART TASKKILL wktaskkill.ps1 (2026-05-28): ./wktaskkill.ps1 /IM wkappbot-core.exe wraps wkappbot taskkill, parses output for [ZOMBIE] and [UNKNOWN] labels, auto-kills those PIDs via --force. PROTECTED processes spared. Commit 91cd2f33. NOTE: output parsing may need adjustment after Core taskkill source review -- verify regex matches actual output format.

SMART TASKKILL CORRECTED (2026-05-28, source-verified): wktaskkill.ps1 auto-kills ZOMBIE only (NOT UNKNOWN). Source: TaskkillCompatCommand.Classify.cs ClassifyOne() stage 5 -- UNKNOWN defaults to PROTECTED by design ('never auto-kill, user must --force explicitly'). wktaskkill.ps1 parses the generated 'wkappbot taskkill --force <pids>  # all zombies' line from classify output to get exact zombie PIDs. Usage: ./wktaskkill.ps1 /IM wkappbot-core.exe. Commit 5369b1c6.

QUICK REFERENCE -- which tool to use (read this first): (A) wkappbot taskkill /IM wkappbot-core.exe = CLASSIFY ONLY, no kill, shows PROTECTED/ZOMBIE/UNKNOWN. (B) wkappbot taskkill --force <pids> = KILL specific PIDs immediately, no questions. (C) ./wktaskkill.ps1 /IM wkappbot-core.exe = SMART: classify + auto-kill ZOMBIE only (UNKNOWN stays protected). (D) ./wkzombie.ps1 -MaxAge 45 = AGE-BASED: kill wkappbot-core processes older than 45s regardless of type. RULES: ZOMBIE=safe to kill. UNKNOWN=same as PROTECTED, never auto-kill (Core design, cannot change). PROTECTED=active session, never kill.

CORRECTION (2026-05-28, source v1.9 verified): wkappbot taskkill /IM wkappbot-core.exe DOES auto-kill ZOMBIE+UNKNOWN immediately. DEFAULT PATH is TaskkillAutoKillNonProtected (v1.9). PROTECTED sessions (Eye/wkchat/mcp/screensaver/agent/claude) are NEVER killed. Only --force <pids> is needed to override protection. The old 'classify-only, no kill' behavior was v1.5 (REMOVED). The file header comment and TaskkillUsage() help text are STALE (v1.5 docs, v1.9 code) -- file suggest to Core to update docs. wktaskkill.ps1 SDK wrapper = REDUNDANT, delete it.

WMI HANG BUG (2026-05-28): IsDescendantOfAiProcess in TaskkillCompatCommand.Helpers.cs calls GetParentProcessId which uses ManagementObjectSearcher WMI. WMI hangs on PID 11940 (unknown system process in ancestor chain). Symptom: wkappbot taskkill /IM bash.exe hangs with no output when bash processes are UNKNOWN (not PROTECTED). Root cause: removing 'claude' from _wkProtectedTokens makes bash=UNKNOWN, then IsDescendantOfAiProcess runs WMI for each bash PID. Fix needed: replace GetParentProcessId WMI call with SafeGetParentPid (NativeMethods.GetParentProcessId, uses NtQueryInformationProcess instead of WMI).

FindCallingAiProcessPid PID-11940 HANG ROOT CAUSE (2026-05-28): NativeAPI (SafeGetParentPid) is faster than WMI, so FindCallingAiProcessPid reaches deeper in the ancestor chain. At depth 5-6 it reaches PID 11940 '?' (end of chain after explorer). Then Process.GetProcessById(11940) hangs. WMI GetParentProcessId is SLOWER so it naturally stops at cmd(74840) before reaching 11940 -- cmd is an AI process (IsAiProcess returns true for cmd), so the loop exits early. Fix: add pid<=4 early-exit check AND timeout on Process.GetProcessById in FindCallingAiProcessPid. Committed: 6e90967d2 (reverted NativeAPI to WMI).

PARTIAL FIX DEPLOYED (commit 493a5b25a): (1) claude token removed from _wkProtectedTokens - bash no longer matched as claude session. (2) AI CLI image-name check added before token loop: image.Equals claude/codex/gemini -> PROTECTED. (3) SafeGetProcessMetrics: Task.Run 100ms timeout. TODO: same Task.Run needed in SafeGetProcessName and SafeGetCreationTime to prevent hang on zombie bash PIDs. Until fully fixed, wkappbot taskkill /IM bash.exe still hangs due to those two functions.

ALL HANGS FIXED (commits af807931e + c29bbd1b2): Every Process.GetProcessById call in TaskkillCompatCommand now wrapped with System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Run 100ms timeout: SafeGetProcessMetrics, SafeGetProcessName, SafeGetCreationTime, PidAlive (Classify.cs) and FindCallingAiProcessPid (Helpers.cs). Also GetProcessCommandLine in TaskkillClassifyPids loop wrapped. Any zombie bash PID that hangs Process.GetProcessById now times out in 100ms and returns safe default. Build pending.

CORRECTION (Opus verified 2026-05-28): wkappbot taskkill /IM bash.exe does NOT auto-kill UNKNOWN bash. Reason: IsDescendantOfAiProcess() check restricts kills to processes in the calling AI's descendant tree. Accumulated bash shells from OTHER sessions or background tasks are NOT descendants -> protected by ancestry -> show as [PROTECTED] even if UNKNOWN. Result: Killed:0 / Protected:N for accumulated bash. To actually kill them: wkappbot taskkill --force <pid1,pid2,...> with specific orphan PIDs (ppid=gone). Implication: skill step 10 'v1.9 auto-kills ZOMBIE+UNKNOWN' is only partially true -- only kills descendants of calling AI.

requirements.expect: CLASSIFY output with 2 lines per process
Eye healthy after zombie cleanup with Stop-Process
KILLED block shows PID + full cmdline
